The Warriors keep finding a way! Golden State rallied from an early double-digit deficit to pull away from the Miami Heat and secure its SIXTH straight win!
The Warriors have now erased double-digit deficits to win each of their last four games—just the second time in franchise history they’ve accomplished that feat in the play-by-play era. The only previous stretch came from February 26–March 3, 2023. Watch the highlights as Golden State keeps its winning streak rolling!
